text: dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline 是面向 DSH Web 聊天的 Trellis 任务状态插件。它在会话标题栏和新会话输入区显示当前会话关联的任务状态，并可展开任务树；没有会话任务时显示工作区任务列表。插件通过只读接口读取工作区中的 Trellis JSON 文件，定时刷新状态，不提供创建、切换或归档任务的操作。适合希望在 DSH 中查看 Trellis 工作进度的用户，无需额外密钥或配置。
想在 DSH 会话里直接看到当前 Trellis 任务。
让新建的 DSH 会话也能显示工作区里有哪些 Trellis 任务。
我想点开当前任务，查看它的父任务和子任务结构。
DSH 里能不能显示 Trellis 任务状态并自动刷新？
Show my current Trellis task in the DSH conversation header.
Can DSH show a workspace task list when a session has no linked task?
功能「会话任务状态」：在普通会话标题栏或空白新会话输入区显示当前 Trellis 任务的优先级、标题和状态，并定时更新。
功能「任务树」：当前任务属于任务树时，点击状态条可展开层级树，显示任务角色和状态并标出当前会话任务。
功能「工作区任务列表」：会话没有自己的任务时显示工作区任务数量；点击可展开任务列表，列出标题和状态。
功能「只读任务状态」：服务端从会话指针及工作区任务 JSON 读取状态，并通过接口交给浏览器显示，不执行 Trellis 任务操作。
dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline 使用前须知：需要会话工作目录中有 Trellis 的 .trellis 数据；插件从本地 JSON 读取任务状态，未提供插件专属配置项。
不想在终端切换窗口，也能在 DSH 网页里查看 Trellis 任务进度。
I want a quick overview of active Trellis workspaces and tasks from DSH.

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline shows Trellis task status in DSH web chat. A pill in the session header or blank-session composer opens the task tree or workspace task list. It reads local Trellis JSON and refreshes periodically. No API key or plugin-specific configuration is needed.

Show the active [Trellis](https://github.com/mindfold-ai/Trellis) task of the current workspace in the [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web chat — the job the Claude Code `statusline.py` hook does in a terminal, and a statusline dsh's web shell does not have.

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline README · Features：- **Session header**: a persistent task pill to the right of the session-preset selector.
- **New-session view**: before the first message has been sent, the pill appears in the composer's dock line just above the input card, sharing that line with the usage pill.
- The pill reads `[priority] title · status`, and marks the task's role in the task tree (parent task / subtask).
- When the task belongs to a tree the pill is clickable; the dropdown shows the tree indented in its real shape and highlights the session's task.
- A session without a task of its own shows the workspace's active-task **count**; clicking the pill opens that list, with a state on every row.
- The workspace list answers "what work does this workspace hold" — no member of it is presented as the session's own task.
- Read-only: it never writes to Trellis and never starts, switches or archives a task; when the workspace holds no task it shows nothing.

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline README · From GitHub (recommended)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:CJ-SH/dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline
```

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline README · From a local directory：```bash
git clone https://github.com/CJ-SH/dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline
```

**Restart dsh** after installing — a plugin is loaded at boot, and the restart ends any running agent process, so run it yourself. No configuration is needed.

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline README · Usage：The pill sits in the session header (right of the session-preset selector), or in the dock line just above the input card for a new session. Four shapes:

```
[P2] Add the importer · 进行中
[P1] Release 0.2 · 进行中 · 父任务
[P2] Wire the importer · 进行中 · 子任务
工作区 3 个活动任务

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline README · Usage：- Stand-alone task: `[P2] Title · 进行中` — no role, no click target, no tab stop.
- Root of the task tree: `[P1] Title · 进行中 · 父任务`; every other member of the tree, grandchildren included: `... · 子任务`.
- Session has no task of its own but the workspace does: `工作区 N 个活动任务`, led by a single list icon. Clicking it opens the workspace's task list — priority, title and state per row, no role, and nothing highlighted as "current".

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline README · Usage：The display refreshes every 10 s, and immediately when you switch sessions, so `task.py start` / `task.py archive` shows up within one poll.

Configuration: none. The plugin reads the session it is rendered in and holds no settings.

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline
```

It stores nothing, so uninstalling needs no cleanup.

dsh-plugin-trellis-statusline README · Technical notes：- Needs dsh `0.2.0-rc.1` or a later `0.2.x`, with the `web` profile; on a version mismatch the row is denied at startup with a message, rather than loading a plugin whose seats have moved.
- Needs Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- Needs a Trellis-managed workspace: run `trellis init --dsh` in it, and the session's working directory contains `.trellis/`, which is all this plugin reads.
- No Python and no `trellis` CLI at runtime — it only reads the JSON Trellis writes.
- The pill's title is truncated to 48 characters, while the rows in the task-tree and workspace dropdowns are not; the seats it attaches to are dsh internals, so a dsh upgrade may move them.
